seo.title: Convert HEIC to PDF Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert HEIC to PDF in your browser: each iPhone photo becomes a one-page PDF. It is decoded here, so the HEIC isn't uploaded. Free, no sign-up.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert HEIC to PDF

tool.subtitle: Turn an iPhone HEIC photo into a PDF, right in your browser.

faqs.question: What size is the page in the HEIC's PDF?
faqs.answer: The page matches the photo: 1 pixel is 1 point, with no margin and no A4 or Letter page. A HEIC gives one page.

faqs.question: Can I merge several HEIC photos into one PDF?
faqs.answer: No. Each HEIC you choose becomes its own PDF, one after another, and several files are never merged into one. There is no ZIP either.

faqs.question: Is the photo recompressed inside the PDF?
faqs.answer: No. The picture is embedded losslessly as a PNG, and the quality setting doesn't apply. The photo is decoded to 8-bit RGB pixels first.

faqs.question: What if my HEIC holds more than one image?
faqs.answer: Only the primary image is decoded, so a HEIC that holds several images gives you one PDF page. The other images in the file are not converted.

faqs.question: Are EXIF data and ICC profiles kept in the PDF?
faqs.answer: No. The decoder turns the photo into 8-bit RGB pixels, so EXIF data and ICC profiles never reach the PDF.

faqs.question: Why does a file fail with No images in HEIF?
faqs.answer: The file has no image the decoder can read, so there is nothing to put in a PDF. Check that the file opens as a photo on your device first.

seo.title: Convert JPEG to PNG Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert JPEG to PNG in your browser. The PNG is lossless, with no quality setting, and the JPEG isn't uploaded. Free, with no sign-up.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert JPEG to PNG

tool.subtitle: Save a JPEG as a lossless PNG, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Will the PNG look better than the JPEG?
faqs.answer: No. The PNG is built from the pixels your browser decodes from the JPEG, so it shows the same picture. PNG is lossless, so saving it again won't cost more quality.

faqs.question: Is the JPEG's EXIF data kept in the PNG?
faqs.answer: No. Your browser decodes the JPEG to raw pixels and the PNG is written from those, so EXIF, ICC profiles and XMP are dropped.

faqs.question: Is there a quality setting for the PNG?
faqs.answer: No. PNG has no quality setting here. It is a lossless format, so the converter doesn't ask you to choose one.

faqs.question: What does Image decode failed mean?
faqs.answer: Your browser couldn't read the file as an image. It may be damaged, or not a JPEG. Try opening it in your browser or another app first.

seo.title: Convert OGG to MP3 Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert OGG to MP3 in your browser: FFmpeg re-encodes the sound as a 192 kbps MP3. Free, with no sign-up, and the OGG isn't uploaded.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert OGG to MP3

tool.subtitle: Re-encode an OGG audio file as a 192 kbps MP3, right in your browser.

faqs.question: What bitrate is the MP3?
faqs.answer: 192 kbps. FFmpeg re-encodes the sound with the LAME encoder at that bitrate, whatever the OGG used.

faqs.question: Will the MP3 sound better than the OGG?
faqs.answer: No. Both formats are lossy, and converting can't add detail the OGG doesn't have. The MP3 is at best as good as its source.

faqs.question: What happens to a video in an OGG file?
faqs.answer: It is dropped. The command asks for no video, so the MP3 holds audio only.

faqs.question: Why does the conversion fail with an FFmpeg error?
faqs.answer: FFmpeg stopped with an exit code, for example because the file has no audio track to save. Check that the file plays with sound first.

seo.title: Convert PDF to EPUB Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert PDF to EPUB in your browser. The text reflows to fit any e-reader; layout, tables and images aren't kept. Free, with no upload.

tool.subtitle: Turn a PDF's text into a reflowable EPUB e-book, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Can you convert a PDF to EPUB without losing format?
faqs.answer: Only the text is kept. Layout, fonts, tables, images, links and form fields are left out, and a table's cells come out as lines. The text reflows instead.

faqs.question: What does the EPUB contain?
faqs.answer: A reflowable EPUB 3 with one part for each PDF page, listed as Page 1, Page 2 and so on in its table of contents. It is titled with your file's name.

faqs.question: Why does my PDF say it has no text to extract?
faqs.answer: No page has any text, as in a scan or a blank PDF. Reading words from a picture needs OCR, which this converter doesn't do.

faqs.question: Can I convert a password-protected PDF?
faqs.answer: Not while it needs a password to open. Save or print a copy without one and convert that. A PDF with only an owner password opens and converts.

faqs.question: How large a PDF can I convert?
faqs.answer: Up to 2,000 pages and 20 million characters of text. Reading that takes at most 2 minutes, then the file is stopped. A larger PDF is refused, and the message names the limit.

seo.title: Convert PNG to JPEG Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert PNG to JPEG in your browser: the JPEG is written at quality 0.85 and metadata is dropped. Free, with no sign-up, and no upload.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert PNG to JPEG

tool.subtitle: Save a PNG as a JPEG at quality 0.85, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Does converting PNG to JPEG reduce quality?
faqs.answer: Yes. A PNG is lossless, but the JPEG is lossy and is written at quality 0.85. Converting back to PNG won't restore what was lost.

faqs.question: Can I pick a quality for the JPEG?
faqs.answer: There is no quality control on this page. The canvas encoder always writes the JPEG at 0.85.

faqs.question: Does the JPEG keep my PNG's transparency?
faqs.answer: No. Transparency is kept only for PNG and WebP outputs. Which colour fills the transparent areas is up to your browser's JPEG encoder.

faqs.question: What happens to an animated PNG?
faqs.answer: An animated input gives its first frame only, so you get a single still JPEG.

seo.description: Convert WebP to JPEG in your browser: an animated WebP gives its first frame, at quality 0.85. Free, with no sign-up, and no upload.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert WebP to JPEG

tool.subtitle: Save a WebP image as a JPEG at quality 0.85, right in your browser.

faqs.question: What happens to an animated WebP?
faqs.answer: You get its first frame only, as a single still JPEG. The rest of the animation is dropped.

faqs.question: What happens to a WebP with transparency?
faqs.answer: JPEG has no transparency, because it is kept only for PNG and WebP outputs. Which colour fills the clear areas is up to your browser's JPEG encoder.

faqs.question: Is the WebP's quality setting carried into the JPEG?
faqs.answer: No. The WebP is decoded to pixels, then the JPEG is written fresh at 0.85, whatever the WebP used.

faqs.question: Do EXIF and XMP tags survive from WebP to JPEG?
faqs.answer: They don't. Only pixels pass through the conversion, so EXIF, ICC profiles and XMP are dropped from the JPEG.

seo.title: Convert MP3 to MP4 Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert MP3 to MP4 in your browser: FFmpeg writes the audio into an MP4 as AAC at 96 kbps and adds no picture. Free, no sign-up, and no upload.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert MP3 to MP4

tool.subtitle: Wrap an MP3 in an MP4 file with AAC audio, right in your browser.

faqs.question: What audio does the MP4 contain?
faqs.answer: AAC at 96 kbps. FFmpeg re-encodes the MP3's sound to that bitrate, so the audio is at best as good as the MP3 it came from.

faqs.question: Is there a picture or video in the MP4?
faqs.answer: The conversion adds no picture of its own: an MP3 without cover art becomes an MP4 with audio only, as AAC at 96 kbps, which plays as audio, not as a video. What happens to cover art already inside the MP3 isn't promised.

faqs.question: Do several MP3 files become one MP4?
faqs.answer: No. Each MP3 you choose is converted on its own, and you download one MP4 for every MP3. Nothing is joined or zipped.

faqs.question: Why does the conversion fail with an FFmpeg error?
faqs.answer: FFmpeg stopped with an exit code. Check that the file plays as audio first. A long file takes as long as your device needs, since there is no timeout.
